hero.lead1: Skills, MCP, models and usage, all in one place.
hero.lead2: No tech skills needed. Just a few clicks.

film.chatA2: is read before anyone signs in.
film.chatReply: Sure. user is empty until someone signs in, so check that it exists before reading its name.

models.sub: Pick a provider, paste your API key, flip the switch. Addresses for {count}+ providers are already filled in, mistakes are caught on the spot, and your official models and past conversations stay put.
models.restarted: {agent} restarted. Official and new models are both there.

skills.title1: See it all at a glance,
skills.title2: fill the gaps in one click.
skills.sub: Sophia finds the skills and MCP servers you already have, no need to add them again. One table shows what each agent is missing and which links are broken. Clicked the wrong one? Press ⌘Z.

usage.sub: Claude and Codex quotas and reset times live in your menu bar. Claude Code and Codex fetch the numbers themselves, so there are no password prompts and your sign-in stays untouched.
usage.none: Usage isn't shown in the menu bar

install.title2: and hand it the config files.
